It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/25024156/profile cottoncandy2502ALT]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} CatDance.gif|First version (9 November 2019 – 29 October 2020) }} ==Trivia== *This [[Emotes|emote]] is based on a GIF of a [https://www.pinterest.com/pin/851602610772847285/ dancing cat], hence the name. **The music that this emote plays is a remixed version of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H9K8-3PHZOU The HampsterDance Song], a song commonly used along with the gif because of an old [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A_6wm8HVaVY youtube video]. *Particles of certain pictures can be seen behind the player when using this emote, all of which are famous memes. **The picture particles are: [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/doge Doge], [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/screaming-cat Screaming Cat] and [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/staring-hamster Staring Hamster]. ==Music Lyrics== {{Scroll|style = width: auto;|text= ''Dibidi ba didi dou dou.''
